answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, we bind each agent’s execution thread to recursive ZK-STARK commitments and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function requiring high staking collateral. Any attempt to clone identities founders upon a cryptographic reef of sequential delay and slashing penalties that render attack utility negative. While legacy designs treat Sybil-free networks as a fable, our primitive enforces a robust Nash equilibrium, securing information-theoretic unforgeability.
